turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: What brings you in here?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I've had this cough for over a week now, and it just hasn't gone away.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and uh, so this cough has been going on for a week. Can you describe the cough a little bit for me?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, so I mean sometimes I produce sputum and sometimes I don't. It's uh, white and whiteish clear in color.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, um, and it's been going on for more than a week.Has it been getting worse?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It got a little bit worse at first, but then it's been kind of the same, um, since.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you noticed at all, um, like green or yellow color of your sputum or any blood tinged sputum?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, No blood, and maybe a little yellowish.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, little yellowish, OK. And how much would you say you bring up, um, on an average day?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, a couple of teaspoons.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Couple of teaspoons OK.OK, has there been anything that um, makes it worse or better?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nothing that I can think of.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had this happen to you previously in the past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And is the cough uh, constant or does it come and go?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It comes and goes, uh, throughout the day. No particular time of the day it's worse.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and, um, are you having any, uh, other symptoms besides the cough, um, like shortness of breath,sore throat, um, runny nose, congestion, anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh. yeah, I've had, um, a sore throat, uh, and a headache, as well.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and when did the sore throat start?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, that started about five days ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Five days ago? And has it been getting worse?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, that's been about the same.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And do you have any difficulty, uh, swallowing at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It's a little sore, but, uh, it's been OK, to eat and drink.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you noticed any kind of redness in your throat or any swelling around your neck?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I took a look in the mirror as best I could with my phone and I couldn't really notice anything that looked red.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how about the headache? When did that start?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So it's been, uh, kind of off and on over the past, uh, week or so. Um, feels like a like a pressure sensation and my head is just really squeezing.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and um. So is it on one side of your head or both sides?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Both sides.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And it's Kind of like a pressure and squeezing. Is it at all pulsating?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No? OK, Is it constant or does it come and go?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It comes and goes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you taken any medications to make any of these symptoms better?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I have used some Advil for the headaches and over the counter medicine at night time to help sleep.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Uh,and do you recall doing anything in the last few weeks which you might believe that Uh, caused some of these symptoms? like for example, were you in contact with anyone that was sick at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Well, I'm a nursing student and I've been on rotations in the hospital recently.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And anyone that you probably saw in the hospital, anyone sick that you were in contact with?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I did see some people who had, like, infectious symptoms.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and other than that, have you been having any fevers or chills?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I've felt chills.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK chills, and when did you feel them?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I've been feeling chills throughout the day and at night, I just feel like I can't get warm even with a blanket on.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you taken your temperature at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK yeah, we can do that for you today. Uh, other than that any recent travel outside of the province.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, been just at school.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and any loss of sense of taste or smell?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any nausea or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any night sweats?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No,

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any fatigue?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and When did that start?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Just over this past week I've been really tired, I've been been needing naps and not feeling rested in the morning.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any chest pain at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, It does feel sore, kind of, uh, the center of my chest.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so any coughing at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I feel it, like more, like it does hurt when when I'm coughing, that's kind of what I'm feeling it. I think it's being caused by how much I'm coughing.I kind of feel it there in the center.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And besides, when you're coughing, do you have any pain in your chest when you're breathing in or out?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No,

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No? OK. Alright, any changes to your bowel movements, like any Constipation or diarrhea?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any urinary issues?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any changes with your sleeping or your appetite?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you noticed any significant weight loss in the last few weeks?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, it's been the same.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And have you recently, prior to your coughing, have you had any infections like a viral illness or like a cold for example, anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, now that I think about it, I mean, maybe like a month ago I had like a runny nose for a couple of days and it just went away.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, were you on any kind of medications or antibiotics at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, just went away on its own pretty quickly.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, do you have any past medical conditions, like high blood pressure, diabetes, anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't, I'm healthy.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, do you have any allergies?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you take any medications regularly?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any hospitalizations or surgeries in the past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and any family history of any lung or heart conditions or any cancers?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I think my mom has high blood pressure, but that's about it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. I forgot to ask you this earlier. Have you been experiencing any wheezing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah I have noticed a bit of a wheeze, yes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And currently you are nursing student. Where do you live?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I live with a couple of my classmates downtown.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and do you live in an apartment or dorm, a house?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: An apartment.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, anyone sick in your household at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nobody's been sick.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, do you drink alcohol at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Sometimes with friends, on a weekend.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you smoke cigarettes at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And any recreational drugs like marijuana?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Alright, so yeah those are all the questions I had for you. Do you have any questions or concerns?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I was just hoping to feel better. It's been going on for so long now.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: You said it's more than a week now, right?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, so what we will do today is, uh, first of all, with the pandemic going on, with some of these symptoms, we need to rule out coronavirus. And so we will be getting a swab done for you as well today and considering you are having these symptoms, we will also get another test done for you today to see if there's any bacteria causing what we call walking pneumonia. It's community acquired pneumonia that's fairly common in like the younger population. And so we'll see if you could have that. And so from there we'll see if we need to put you on any antibiotics which will help you. And if we need to get any blood work or X Rays we'll let you know as well. Is that OK? And if you feel like you have worsening symptoms like shortness of breath, you need to make sure you come back to the Emergency Department.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, that sounds great. Thank you.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, you're welcome and take care, and we'll get all those things done for you and we'll be with you shortly.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: OK, sounds good.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Great.
